metadata.title: Monochromatic Multi-Exposure Portrait with Tally Graphic

recipe.visualDefinition: A desaturated, grainy composite of multiple translucent male portraits layered horizontally, overlaid with a large, vibrant red hand-painted tally mark graphic and serif display text.
coreVisualRelationships: High-contrast red graphic against a desaturated grey background
Translucent overlapping figures creating a sense of motion or multiplicity
Rough, painterly brushstroke texture of the central icon versus the photographic grain of the portraits
Top-left alignment of text balancing the central-heavy graphic
coreInvariants: Heavy film grain and vertical streaking texture

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Multiple portraits span the horizontal mid-ground; the tally graphic occupies the central foreground at a large scale.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large red tally mark graphic in the center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the red text in the top left, moves across the faces, and settles on the central red graphic.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the composition is densely packed with overlapping figures and texture.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Mid-tone grey and silver (background and subjects)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation for the red elements against zero saturation for the photographic elements.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single serif font paired with a hand-drawn illustrative icon.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the traditional serif structure and sharp terminals.
Provides the necessary high contrast and elegant serifs.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a monochromatic, desaturated composite of five translucent male portraits layered horizontally. Apply a heavy film grain and vertical streaking texture resembling rain on glass. The overall tone should be moody and grey.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, hand-painted red tally mark graphic (four vertical strokes, one diagonal) in the center. Add uppercase serif text in the top left corner in the same vibrant red.

verificationChecks: Is the red color consistent between text and graphic?
Are the portraits sufficiently translucent to see overlaps?
Is the vertical texture present across the entire image?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subjects
Exact brushstroke patterns of the tally marks

mustAchieve: Clear contrast between red and grey

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the tally marks look hand-painted with rough edges.
Check that the text is legible but does not overpower the central graphic.
Verify the monochromatic palette is strictly maintained for the background.
Confirm the vertical 'rain' texture is visible over the subjects.
recipe.reuseFormula: Layered monochrome portraits + vertical grain texture + central hand-drawn red icon + top-left serif display text.
